# Lucky Loki

> AI face swap app for photos and short video clips, for iPhone, iPad and Android.
> Operated by Coiner.Cab Corp.

Lucky Loki replaces a face in a photo or a video clip with a different face. Faces are detected
automatically — there is no masking, cut-outs or timeline editing. It handles both still images
and short video, using the same workflow for each.

Platforms:
- iOS / iPadOS app (App Store, id6445939137). Also runs on Apple silicon Macs and Apple Vision Pro.
- Android app (Google Play, com.coinercab.luckyloki)

Pricing: Lucky Loki Pro is an auto-renewing subscription with weekly, monthly and quarterly
plans. The quarterly plan includes a 3-day free trial. Prices are shown in the app and vary
by country.

Output is synthetic media (AI-generated or AI-manipulated content). Use requires the right to
the source material and explicit permission from every identifiable person whose likeness
appears in the result. Sexual or intimate content, content depicting anyone under 18,
impersonation for fraud or deception, political and election-related content, and harassment
are prohibited. Users must be 16 or older.
